generated_mmmc:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
create_library_set -name tiny -timing [list $root/.cache/physical/library/tcbn28hpcplusbwp12t40p140tt1v25c.lib]
create_rc_corner -name rc -temperature 25
create_timing_condition -name tc -library_sets {tiny}
create_delay_corner -name dc -timing_condition tc -rc_corner rc
create_constraint_mode -name functional -sdc_files [list $out/canary.sdc]
create_analysis_view -name view -constraint_mode functional -delay_corner dc
set_analysis_view -setup {view} -hold {view}
generated_warm_tcl:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
set_multi_cpu_usage -local_cpu 1
set_db init_design_uniquify false
read_mmmc $out/canary_mmmc.tcl
read_physical -lefs [list \
 $root/.cache/physical/routing_kit/N28_PRTF_Cad_v1d5a/PR_tech/Cadence/LefHeader/VHV/tsmcn28_10lm5X2Y2ZUTRDL.tlef \
 $root/.cache/physical/library/tcbn28hpcplusbwp12t40p140.lef]
read_netlist $out/canary.v -top unique215_canary_top
init_design
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_preservation233.tcl
tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/before_targets.tsv 2
uniquify unique215_canary_top -verbose
tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/after_targets.tsv 2
write_sdc -view view $out/before.sdc
write_db $out/canary.db
puts TRI234_WARM_PRESERVATION_SAVED
exit
generated_cold_tcl:
set root $::env(TRI215_ROOT)
set out $::env(TRI215_OUT)
read_db $out/canary.db
set_multi_cpu_usage -local_cpu 1
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_unique215_snapshot.tcl
source $root/syn/tri_oracle_preservation233.tcl
tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/cold_targets.tsv 2
tri215_snapshot $out before_fault
set_interactive_constraint_modes {functional}
set_dont_touch [get_cells clone0] false
tri215_snapshot $out after_fault
write_sdc -view view $out/mutated.sdc
if {![catch {tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/fault_targets.tsv 2} reason] ||
    $reason ne "TRI223_PRESERVATION_TARGET_NOT_PROTECTED clone0"} {error TRI234_HIERARCHICAL_FAULT_NOT_REJECTED}
puts "TRI234_HIERARCHICAL_FAULT_REJECTED $reason"
update_constraint_mode -name functional -sdc_files [list $out/canary.sdc]
if {![catch {tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/after_reload_fault_targets.tsv 2} reason] ||
    $reason ne "TRI223_PRESERVATION_TARGET_NOT_PROTECTED clone0"} {error TRI234_RELOAD_BEHAVIOR_CHANGED}
puts "TRI234_FAULT_STILL_REJECTED_AFTER_MODE_RELOAD $reason"
set_dont_touch [get_cells clone0] true
tri233_preservation $out/canary.sdc $out/restored_targets.tsv 2
foreach {name expected} {
    duplicate TRI223_DUPLICATE_PRESERVATION_TARGET
    missing TRI223_PRESERVATION_TARGET_COUNT
    wrong TRI223_PRESERVATION_TARGET_NOT_UNIQUE
    pattern TRI223_PRESERVATION_TARGET_NAME_CHANGED
    unsupported TRI223_UNSUPPORTED_PRESERVATION_SELECTOR
} {
    if {![catch {tri233_preservation $out/$name.sdc $out/[set name]_targets.tsv 2} reason] ||
        [lindex $reason 0] ne $expected} {error "TRI234_SELECTOR_FAULT_NOT_REJECTED $name $reason"}
    puts "TRI234_SELECTOR_FAULT_REJECTED $name $reason"
}
puts TRI234_COLD_PRESERVATION_CONTROL_PASSED
exit
